import re
import sys

set_value = re.compile(r"\s*([A-Za-z]+)\s*<-\s*(\d+)\s*;\s*")
add_mod = re.compile(
    r"\s*([A-Za-z]+)\s*<-\s*\(\s*([A-Za-z]+)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)"
    r"\s*mod\s+100\s*;\s*"
)

values = {}

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = set_value.fullmatch(line)
    if match:
        target, number = match.groups()
        values[target] = int(number)
        continue

    match = add_mod.fullmatch(line)
    if match:
        target, source, number = match.groups()
        values[target] = (values[source] + int(number)) % 100

print(
    f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; "
    f"c ?= {values['c']}; d ?= {values['d']}; "
    f"TMP ?= {values['TMP']};"
)
